limitations.note: The rewrite accounts for the correct coin values but replaces the FSM’s combinational output decode with registered outputs and changes how held inputs, simultaneous coins, and change payout are handled; the reference fix changes only two transition targets.
The testbench used the rewrite’s own coin-accounting and output-timing rules as its oracle, so its 10,030 passing cycles did not verify the two faulty transitions under the original FSM’s behavior.
The entry the agent read concerned duplicate state encodings, whereas this FSM had distinct encodings and two incorrect transition destinations.
